dedupe_keys.name: points marquants du reseau routier regional

description: Points marquants du réseau routier régional is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SPW-MI Mobilité et Infrastructures. This collection of data consists of the following data layers: - Motorway areas; - Carpooling areas; - Crossings (trafic lights and roundabouts); - Interchanges and motorways; - Structures (bridges, tunnels, retaining walls); - Level crossings; - Pedestrian crossings ("school proximity" and others). Coverage: SPW-MI Mobilité et Infrastructures. The portal shows the English title as "Highlights of the regional road network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SPW-MI Mobilité et Infrastructures. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 2025-07-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.be/.well-known/genid/63236b7128d642e2a86d55d8b03caaf52-54021D28A9A813B1DB417201A5DA890F). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
